messages:
marta: FYI billing just flagged ~12% of eu-west GPUs billed as on-demand not reserved. Reservation queue not progressing for several large commits. Anyone hitting this?
jay: Yea I saw spikes around 03:10 UTC, jobs stuck in 'pending' because pool shows less reserved capacity. Dashboard shows reserved capacity at 88% but cloud billing indicates only 76% reserved.
andre: @billing-bot can you paste the raw line items? we need exact SKU and regions.
billing-bot: Pulled last 24h items: 
```
SKU: GPU_NVIDIA_A100_80GB-eu-west1
ReservedCommitment: 120
BilledCommitted: 94
OnDemand: 26
LineItems: invoice_2026_03_14.csv
```
marta: That matches queue depth. Ops assumption: reservations were rebalanced last night; maybe a mis-tag. @samir can you check the terraform state re: reserved pool tags?
samir: digging. Terraform shows reserved_pool.eu-west1 count=120, but cloud console reports 94 active commitments. Running reconcile script now.
rachel: If cloud provider cancelled some commitments due to billing auth failure last month, we might need to re-request. Cost impact: on-demand diff ~$2.40/hr per GPU — estimate +$60k/mo if not corrected.
andre: Proposed immediate mitigation: 1) Temporarily bump higher-priority queue to global burst pool 2) Re-request missing commitments 3) Open billing dispute. Anyone object?
jay: +1. Need manual override on reservation queue to avoid customer impact. @marta can you approve priority bump for prow-inference?
marta: approved. @ops-bot please run queue-priority bump for channel=prow-inference amount=20 region=eu-west1 reason='billing-mismatch emergency'
ops-bot: Running: `./scripts/priority-bump --channel prow-inference --amount 20 --region eu-west1` -> DONE. New allocations: +20 GPUs moved from global-burst. Note: this borrows capacity without reserve.
samir: Reconcile script found 26 commitments in 'pending' state due to expired PO tags. I'll reapply tags and trigger cloud commitment API.
billing-bot: Created ticket to cloud provider: TKT-43219 — 'Commitment undercount eu-west1' with attachment of line items.
marta: Good. Ops action owners: samir to fix infra tags + reapply commitments (ETA 45m), andre to open cost/ops alert and estimate runbook, rachel to prepare projection for finance. If commitment reactivation fails, we'll submit new reserved capacity order and adjust forecasts.
rachel: noted. I'll post updated spend projection in #finance-alerts when we confirm.
jay: Also, let's add an automatic alert if billed_committed / desired_reserved < 0.95 for any region. I'll open a PR after lunch.
marta: Thanks. Keep thread up to date. :thumbsup:
